Nonsyndromic hereditary hearing loss; hearing impairment is obligate.

Malignant neoplasm of supportive mesenchymal soft tissues; specific visceral sites apply only to subtypes.

Invasive Candida infection; the umbrella spans sterile compartments without one additional organ consistently affected. Candidemia alone is not blood-cell disease.

Inherited rod-cone retinal degeneration with visual impairment and chorioretinal atrophy.
Defined by progressive spastic paraplegia and distal muscle wasting; explicitly classified as an inherited phospholipid metabolism disorder.
Basal cell carcinoma originating in skin and infiltrating the dermis.
Combined immunodeficiency with defining chronic cutaneous disease; bronchiectasis (~42%) and respiratory/ear infections are separately diagnosed secondary diseases.
